import importlib.util,pathlib,time,json,subprocess,os
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('review',pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('run-review.py'));r=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(r)
while True:
 entries=[json.loads(x) for x in r.COMMANDS.read_text().splitlines()]
 done=next((x for x in entries if x['label']=='http16'),None)
 if done:
  assert done['exitCode']==0
  break
 time.sleep(2)
for port in [4395,5295]:
 q=subprocess.run(['lsof','-nP','-iTCP:'+str(port),'-sTCP:LISTEN'],capture_output=True);assert not q.stdout, 'Own test port still occupied'
old=r.ROOT/'artifacts/.review-round9-old';ci=r.ROOT/'artifacts/.review-round9-ci'
for c in [old,ci]:assert not (c/'.env').exists()
old_db=r.newdb('old_noenv');oldenv={'DATABASE_URL':old_db,'TILESET_ASSET_ROOT':'.local/step07-review/assets/old-noenv','API_PORT':'4395','WEB_PORT':'5295'}
r.run('old-migrate',['pnpm','db:migrate'],cwd=old,env=oldenv)
r.run('old-two-browser-enoent',['pnpm','exec','playwright','test','--grep','1300ms legal poll|project switches keep real'],cwd=old,env=oldenv,expected=1)
report=json.loads((old/'.local/e2e/production.json').read_text());assert report['stats']['unexpected']==2
text=(r.OUT/'old-two-browser-enoent.log').read_text();assert text.count('ENOENT: no such file or directory')==2
(r.EVID/'old-noenv-reproduction.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source='c8d41a680df42fe565882d93d3f85a04f7a10b22',noEnvReadback=True,stats=report['stats'],result='TWO_REAL_BROWSER_CASES_ENOENT_REPRODUCED_NOT_CANDIDATE_PASS'),indent=2)+'\n')
for mode in ['production','dev']:
 for port in [4395,5295]:
  q=subprocess.run(['lsof','-nP','-iTCP:'+str(port),'-sTCP:LISTEN'],capture_output=True);assert not q.stdout
 assert not (ci/'.env').exists()
 db=r.newdb('browser_'+mode);env={'DATABASE_URL':db,'TILESET_ASSET_ROOT':'.local/step07-review/assets/'+mode,'API_PORT':'4395','WEB_PORT':'5295','E2E_MODE':mode}
 asset=ci/env['TILESET_ASSET_ROOT'];assert not asset.exists()
 r.run(mode+'-migrate',['pnpm','db:migrate'],cwd=ci,env=env)
 r.run(mode+'-e2e18',['pnpm','test:e2e'],cwd=ci,env=env)
 report=json.loads((ci/('.local/e2e/'+mode+'.json')).read_text());assert report['stats']['expected']==18 and report['stats']['unexpected']==0 and report['stats']['skipped']==0
 assert not (ci/'.env').exists()
 (r.EVID/(mode+'-e2e-summary.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(source='50fd6d84197b8c6d222f139a142ab24c918db0db',noEnvReadbackBeforeAndAfter=True,stats=report['stats'],cwd=str(ci),assetRoot=str(asset)),indent=2)+'\n')
print('all actual browser workflows completed',flush=True)
